import bpy
hull = bpy.data.objects["Hull"]
for name in ("Mast", "Sail"):
    child = bpy.data.objects[name]
    child.parent = hull
    child.matrix_parent_inverse = hull.matrix_world.inverted()

import bpy, math
top = bpy.data.objects["Lantern"].location
pivot = bpy.data.objects.new("BeamPivot", None)
bpy.data.objects["Lantern"].users_collection[0].objects.link(pivot)
pivot.location = top
mat = bpy.data.materials.new("BeamMat")
mat.use_nodes = True
nt = mat.node_tree
nt.nodes.clear()
add = nt.nodes.new
coord, sep, power, glow = add("ShaderNodeTexCoord"), add("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ"), add("ShaderNodeMath"), add("ShaderNodeEmission")
clear, total, out = add("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent"), add("ShaderNodeAddShader"), add("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
power.operation = "POWER"
power.inputs[1].default_value = 3.0
glow.inputs["Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.78, 0.45, 1)
for a, b in ((coord.outputs["Generated"], sep.inputs[0]), (sep.outputs["Z"], power.inputs[0]),
             (power.outputs[0], glow.inputs["Strength"]), (clear.outputs[0], total.inputs[0]),
             (glow.outputs[0], total.inputs[1]), (total.outputs[0], out.inputs["Surface"])):
    nt.links.new(a, b)
length, radius = params["length"], params["radius"]
for i, side in enumerate((1, -1)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=48, radius1=radius, radius2=0.05, depth=length)
    beam = bpy.context.object
    beam.name = f"Beam{i}"
    beam.rotation_euler = (0, -side * math.pi / 2, 0)
    beam.location = (side * length / 2, 0, 0)
    beam.parent = pivot
    beam.data.materials.append(mat)
    beam.visible_shadow = beam.visible_diffuse = beam.visible_glossy = False
